assumptions: Path: metrics/mod.rs:2621-2624 -> run_cpu_gmsd (mod.rs:2909-2922) -> gmsd::gmsd_rgb8 (lib.rs:461-485) -> run_sources (lib.rs:619-690) -> kernel::gmsd_band (kernel.rs:561-641 band_body macro).

Counted scalar reference semantics per the lane conventions: the fused sRGB8->gray+2x2-downsample SIMD path (rgb8_pair_half_row_body, kernel.rs:182-239, integer luma + boundary fixup) is counted as its scalar tail ds_px(4x gray_px); results are bit-identical. gray_px (kernel.rs:92-95) runs f64: 0.299R+0.587G+0.114B (3 mul + 2 add) +0.5 (add), floor via f64->i64->f64 (2 cvt), ->f32 (1 cvt), 3x u8->f64 cvt.

v2 conventions: the 3-slot ring re-fills the 2 boundary rows per band -> overlap rows = 2*(NB2-1), NB2=ceil(H2/64), counted as the separate implementation-class stage gray2x2_ovr. Out-of-range fills (row -1, row H2) are zero-fills, not counted.
Prewitt: 3x3 zero-padded on the half-res grid; the zero taps (m1 in hy) are skipped as written -> 6 mul + 5 add per gradient component, 8 loads per image per element.

GMS pooling: f64 per-element accumulate (1-q, e^2) inside gms_row (acc8!, kernel.rs:402-414) split out as pool_acc; lib.rs::pool folds per-row (sum_e, sum_e2) pairs then one scalar finalize (std2 convention, n-1).

Radius convention (v2): the 2x2 box decimator reaches 1 input sample on both axes (axis xy, radius 1, scale 1); Prewitt radius 1 at scale 2. Cumulative halo = 3 input px per axis (the crate's own MapGeometry::with_halo(2,2) measures halo beyond the owned cell - different convention).
map=None path (CLI): the GMS map is still computed into a reusable scratch row per band - per-element work identical to the map-producing path.
bytes_* = compulsory traffic (input planes read once, output written once); per-tap stencil reads are only in 'load'.

stages.name: sRGB8->gray (f64 luma) + 2x2 average decimate
stages.notes: Per element per image: 4x gray_px (each 3 mul + 3 add + 6 cvt, 3 u8 loads) + ds_px (4 mul + 3 add) -> mul 16, add 15, cvt 24, load 12 u8, store 1 f32.

stages.name: ring re-fill of 2 boundary rows per band
stages.notes: Same per-element ops as gray2x2 on the rows shared by adjacent bands (band needs y0-1..y1). No depends_on: reads the original input grid, not gray2x2 output.

stages.name: Prewitt gradient magnitude + GMS map
stages.notes: Per image: hx = 6 mul + 5 add, hy = 6 mul + 5 add, g = sqrt(hx^2+hy^2) = 2 mul + 1 add + 1 sqrt -> mul 14, add 11, sqrt 1; both images x2. GMS q = ((2*g1)*g2 + c)/((g1^2+g2^2) + c): 4 mul + 3 add + 1 div. 8 loads/image of the padded row window (m1 tap skipped).

stages.name: f64 per-element sums of e=1-q and e^2
stages.notes: e = 1.0 - q as f64 (cvt + add); acc1 += e (add); acc2 += e*e (mul + add). Logically the second pass of std2 fused into the map pass.

stages.name: fold per-row (sum_e, sum_e2) pairs
stages.notes: s1 += a; s2 += b over H2 band-row sums.

stages.name: std2: mean, variance (n-1), sqrt
stages.notes: mean_e = s1/n; var = (s2 - s1*mean_e)/(n-1) clamped >=0; gmsd = sqrt(var); mean_gms = 1 - mean_e. cvt is n as f64.
